# **Mealvana for Endurance Athletes — What It Does (and Why It Wins)**

## **One-liner**

**Mealvana turns your training plan into fuel-in-hand and execution-on-course**: personalized plans, auto-generated shopping and prep, and device nudges that make the plan actually happen.

## **Who it’s for**

Serious recreational to competitive **runners, triathletes, cyclists, and ultrarunners** training for events from half-marathon to Ironman/ultra. Works for athletes who prefer **sports products or real food**, and those with **GI sensitivity, heat/sweat challenges, or female-specific needs.**

---

# **The Wedge**

Most apps stop at “60–90 g carbs/hr.” **Mealvana closes the loop**:

1. **Plan** (personalized by training load, race, weather, sweat, GI, cycle phase)
2. **Procure** (groceries & products auto-listed; DIY mix formulas; cost optimizer)
3. **Execute** (push to Garmin/Wahoo/Apple Watch; time-based nudges; bottle math; aid-station aware)
4. **Learn** (compliance + GI diary → adaptive next plan)

---

# **Core Jobs (grounded in the demand data)**

- **Race-day fueling plan**: carbs/hr, fluid/hr, sodium/hr, caffeine dosing, carry strategy.
- **Training fueling**: long runs/rides, two-a-days, gut training progression.
- **Race-week**: carb-load, low-residue prep, hydration priming.
- **Recovery**: immediate post-session and multi-day rebuild.
- **Hot weather & sweat variability**: environmental adaptation.
- **GI troubleshooting**: alternatives by ingredient profile; flavor-fatigue rotation.
- **“Grocery list to race pack” bridge**: what to buy, how to mix, what to pack.

---

# **Product Pillars & Key Features**

## **1) Personalization Engine**

- **Inputs**: sport & event (HM → Ironman/ultra), target duration/power/pace, training calendar import, height/weight, sweat self-test, sodium preference, GI history, diet pattern, budget, brand/library preferences.
- **Female mode**: optional **cycle-aware adjustments** (hydration, iron prompts, carb emphasis in luteal phase).
- **Environment-aware**: race **forecast & altitude** → adjust fluid/sodium and carb form (drink vs gel).

## **2) Plan Builders**

- **Race Plan Wizard**: creates a **minute-by-minute schedule** (carbs, fluids, sodium, caffeine), **carry plan** (how many gels/bottles; concentration), and **aid-station logic** (what to grab, what to skip).
- **Training Day Autoplan**: based on workout type from TrainingPeaks/Strava/Garmin, recommends **pre-fuel, during-fuel, and recovery** with gut-training progression.
- **Carb-Load Composer (48–72h)**: grams/day by body mass, low-fiber guidance, sample menus.
- **Recovery Builder**: 3 timing windows (0–30 min, 30–90 min, evening), with **real-food + product** options.

## **3) Real-Food Parity + Product Intelligence**

- **Dual database**: branded products **and** whole foods (bananas, rice cakes, dates, pretzels, PB&J, etc.).
- **Equivalent swaps**: “1 Maurten 100 ≈ 25g carbs → try ½ PB&J + 8 pretzels if gels upset you.”
- **DIY Mix Mode**: simple sugar/salt ratios, bottle math, **taste rotation** to fight flavor fatigue.
- **Cost optimizer**: hit targets with **cheaper combos** (real food or bulk mix) and show **monthly savings**.

## **4) Execute Mode (where most apps fail)**

- **Device push**: send fuel steps/alerts to **Garmin/Wahoo/Apple Watch** (e.g., 20g carbs every 15 min; sip prompts).
- **Bottle & Gel Math**: concentration calculator + “exact scoop count,” **backup plan** if you drop a gel.
- **Race Card**: printable/mobile card: schedule, totals, pack list, **“what if” contingencies**.
- **Prep checklist**: “Mix bottles at 8pm (X scoops), tape gels to top tube, freeze bottles if >80°F.”

## **5) Learn & Adapt**

- **Tap-to-log during race** (optional) or **auto-reconcile** after syncing the workout: how close you were to plan.
- **GI Diary**: mark issues and ingredients → **avoidance heuristics** (e.g., maltodextrin-heavy gels).
- **Gut Training Score**: weekly metric showing tolerance improving toward target carbs/hr.
- **Nudges**: “Hard session tomorrow → add 30–60g carbs at dinner.”

## **6) Coach & Team Console (B2B wedge)**

- **Templates by event**; bulk-assign; monitor compliance; athlete flags (low intake, recurrent GI).
- **Comment/adjust** racer cards; export to athletes’ devices.
- Tiered pricing for squads/clubs.

# **User Scenarios**

## **1) Jess (First Marathon, 4:15 goal, nervous stomach)**

- Connects TrainingPeaks; picks **Marathon – Chicago**.
- Mealvana builds **Race Week**: 2-day carb load (~8–10 g/kg), low-residue checklist; race-morning breakfast (2–3 h pre).
- **Race Plan**: 60–75 g carbs/hr, 400–600 mL/hr, sodium 400–600 mg/L, caffeine 100 mg pre + 50 mg at 20 km.
- **Real-food tilt**: plan uses **chews + sports drink**, with **banana alternative** queued if gels feel risky.
- **Execution**: alerts on Apple Watch every 15 min; printable **Race Card**; pack list.
- **After**: logs minor slosh at mile 10 → app suggests **smaller, more frequent sips** next time.

## **2) Omar (70.3 in Austin, “salty sweater,” rides hot)**

- Inputs sweat test estimate; selects **Bike-heavy fueling** with **high sodium**.
- App sets **90 g carbs/hr on bike, 60 g on run**, **600–800 mL/hr fluids**, **1000–1500 mg sodium/L**.
- **Bottle math**: two concentrated bottles on bike + aid-station water; **backup gel** in bento.
- **DIY mix** provided to cut cost; shows **$28 saved** this race vs all-gels.
- Pushes to Garmin; ride computer pops **“sip/eat”** nudges.
- Report: nailed the run → app locks in this sodium target for future hot races.

## **3) Lin (Female marathoner, luteal phase race week, prior low iron)**

- Enables **Female Mode**; notes **luteal phase** on race week; app recommends **slightly higher total carbs**, **hydration priming**, and **iron-rich meals earlier in week**.
- Chooses **GI-gentle** options (Maurten-style gels or rice balls).
- App schedules **caffeine** at conservative dosing to avoid jitters.
- Shopping list includes **iron-supportive foods** (with vitamin-C pairings).
- Post-race: logs zero GI issues → plan marked “sticky.”

## **4) Diego (Gravel Century, real-food preference)**

- Selects **real-food priority**; app builds menu of **rice cakes, dates, PB&J**, plus **electrolyte tabs**.
- **Aid-station aware**: uses course map to plan what to grab where; minimizes heavy carry.
- Cost optimizer shows **>50% cheaper** than gels while hitting **75–90 g/hr**.
- Execution with Wahoo prompts; post-ride: minor flavor fatigue → app rotates flavors next time.

## **5) Coach Maya (20-athlete tri squad)**

- Imports roster; applies **70.3 template** with heat variants to 8 athletes racing Chattanooga.
- Sees compliance dashboard: 3 under-fueled long rides flagged.
- Leaves comments; pushes updated race cards; prints team **“special-needs”** pack sheets.
- End of season exports **compliance vs PR improvement** for marketing.

# **Data & Integrations (pragmatic)**

- **In**: TrainingPeaks/Final Surge/Garmin/Strava (workouts & events), weather, optional cycle tracking (Apple Health/Clue).
- **Out**: Garmin/Wahoo/Apple Watch alerts, printable PDFs, shareable “Race Card.”
- **Food**: Mealvana DB (real food + branded), barcode scan later; import common foods from MFP/MacroFactor (read-only) if feasible.

# **Example Output (what users actually see)**

**Race Card — 70.3 (Omar)**

- **Breakfast (05:30)**: 110–130 g carbs, low-fiber; 500 mL electrolyte (750 mg sodium).
- **Swim**: optional 100 mg caffeine 20–30 min pre.
- **Bike (2h45)**: 90 g carbs/hr via 2× concentrated bottles + 1 gel/hr; 700 mL/hr fluids; **1500 mg sodium/L**. **Prompt every 15 min**.
- **Run (1h55)**: 60 g carbs/hr via aid-station drink + chews; 500–600 mL/hr; 100 mg caffeine at 30–40 min.
- **Totals**: ~360–380 g carbs, ~3.2–3.6 L fluid, ~4.5–5.0 g sodium.
- **Pack List**: 6 gels (2 caf), 2× 750 mL bottles (X scoops each), 6 chews, salt tabs backup, tape, flasks.
- **What-ifs**: Drop a gel → take half bottle + 1 chew at next alert.
